query:
Last weekend I took my golden retriever to the new dog park downtown, and he had the best time chasing after a border collie that brought a bright orange frisbee. We stopped at the pet supply shop on the way home, and I picked up a bag of salmon-flavored treats that he’s been begging for nonstop ever since. Yesterday I even found a cute little raincoat for him online that’s bright yellow, just like a duck, and it should arrive next week.

Now I actually need help with two things for my orders: first, for my pending order #W3295833, please modify the items by replacing items 8926329222 and 5312063289 with items 7160999700 and 6956751343, and use the payment method credit_card_3261838 for any adjustments from that change. Second, for my delivered order #W8488728, I need to return item 5676696062, and please process the refund to my paypal_3650980 account.
